summary: Scene list and data cleanup (thiscall destructor-style routine). Releases primary scene-list resources via SceneListCleanup(this), then walks a singly linked list rooted at this+0x8, freeing each node's data payload when the node's ownership flag (byte at node+8) is set and freeing each node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf. Zeroes the four list pointers at this+0x8 through this+0x14 to mark cleanup complete, then frees the primary pointer at this+0x0 if non-null. Returns the earlier SceneListCleanup result when no primary pointer was freed.

local_names.v5: zero flag for the node ownership byte at node+8
local_names.v6: primary scene list pointer read from this+0x0

operations.description: SceneListCleanup(this) releases the primary scene-list resources; its return value becomes the initial result.
Walk the singly linked list starting at the head stored in this+0x8 (this[2]), advancing via the next pointer at node+4 (i[1]) until the cursor is null.
Read the node ownership flag byte at node+8; when it is zero the node's data payload is not freed.
When the node ownership flag is non-zero, free the node's data payload (pointer stored at node+0) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free each node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v4); this call is the loop iteration expression whose result is assigned to result.
Zero the list head and auxiliary pointers at this+0x8, this+0xC, this+0x10 and this+0x14 to mark the cleanup as complete.
Deterministic guard (packet guard 0): the field at this+0x10 is tested for equality with 0; the field is unconditionally zeroed at the end of the walk.
If the primary scene-list pointer at this+0x0 is non-null, it is freed; otherwise the earlier SceneListCleanup result is returned.
Free the primary scene-list pointer (this+0x0) via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v6) when non-null.
Return the FreeWrapper_7bcf result when the primary pointer was freed, otherwise the earlier result from SceneListCleanup.
